slides.headline: 99 Jamz gave Khaled his first recognition
slides.body: Khaled first gained recognition as a radio host in the 1990s for Miami station 99 Jamz.

photo.query: WEDR 99 Jamz radio studio Wikimedia Commons
photo.prompt: close-up of a radio studio microphone, headphones, and mixing board with an ON AIR light glowing

slides.headline: He moved to Miami in 1998
slides.body: In 1998, Khaled moved to Miami and co-hosted The Luke Show on WEDR 99 Jamz with Luther Campbell.

photo.query: Miami radio studio microphone Wikimedia Commons
photo.prompt: radio studio scene with two microphones, headphones, and a broadcast console in Miami

slides.headline: He kept building at 99 Jamz in 2003
slides.body: In 2003, he started hosting a weeknight radio show on 99 Jamz called The Takeover.

photo.query: late-night radio studio ON AIR sign Wikimedia Commons

slides.headline: That radio run led to Terror Squad work
slides.body: He then worked with Fat Joe's Terror Squad as a live DJ and producer before his debut album in 2006.
